title: Luxury Showroom Product Configurator
description: An interactive luxury furniture showroom where a leather sofa is displayed on a rotating platform alongside a sci-fi helmet as a decorative accent piece. Users configure the showroom by adjusting lighting color temperature, rotating the platform, repositioning the helmet on or near the sofa, toggling spotlight effects, adjusting camera zoom, and capturing a final product shot with validated parameters.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a luxury product showroom configurator. Load both GLB models using GLTFLoader: place SheenWoodLeatherSofa centered on a circular platform (a CylinderGeometry with metallic material, radius 3, height 0.15) at y=0. Place DamagedHelmet scaled to 0.8 sitting on the right armrest of the sofa (approximate position x=1.2, y=1.1, z=0). Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2.5, 6) looking at the platform center. Add an HDR-style lighting rig: one warm DirectionalLight from above-left, one cool RimLight (DirectionalLight) from behind-right, and one SpotLight pointing down at the sofa with shadow mapping enabled. Create a dark gradient background using scene.background with a Color. Build an HTML overlay panel with these interactive controls: (1) A range slider for platform rotation (0-360 degrees) that rotates the entire platform group. (2) Three buttons to reposition the helmet to predefined locations: left armrest, right armrest, or on the sofa seat cushion, with smooth lerp animation over 0.5 seconds. (3) A color temperature slider (2700K-6500K) that adjusts the main DirectionalLight color between warm orange-white and cool blue-white using linear interpolation. (4) A spotlight intensity slider (0-3) controlling the overhead SpotLight. (5) A camera zoom slider that adjusts camera FOV between 30 and 75 degrees with camera.updateProjectionMatrix(). (6) A 'Capture Shot' button that validates all parameters are not at defaults (platform rotation != 0, helmet moved at least once, color temp adjusted, spotlight changed, zoom changed) before showing a green confirmation overlay saying 'Product Shot Saved'. If validation fails, highlight missing steps in red text. Use OrbitControls with damping enabled but constrain polar angle between 0.3 and 1.4 radians. Add a subtle ambient animation where the SpotLight gently pulses in intensity using a sine wave. Render with antialiasing, toneMapping set to ACESFilmicToneMapping, and outputColorSpace set to SRGBColorSpace.
